items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bob got these guys. I know Gary King was on there.

ctx.x: He did some funky stuff, because he did the session with Sly, playing in time. It was like, nobody playing . . .
Bob got these guys. I know Gary King was on there. That’s for sure. He died too.

Right. You mentioned that earlier. It’s unfortunate. The next big date is with Bob James, Bob James Three. I remember all these, Bob James Three, Bob James Four. Large band. It’s got strings on there. One Mint Julep. Any recollection about this one?
